name: Better Stack MCP
description: Connects AI assistants to Better Stack: check uptime monitors, manage incidents and on-call, and query logs, metrics and traces. For SRE and DevOps teams.

skills.name: Monitors & Heartbeats
skills.description: Lists monitors and heartbeats, checks their availability and response times, and creates, updates, pauses or removes them.

skills.name: Manage Incidents
skills.description: Creates, acknowledges, escalates, resolves and reopens incidents, and reads timelines and adds comments along the way.

skills.name: On-Call & Escalation Policies
skills.description: Shows who is on call for a calendar, lists upcoming shifts and rotations, and adds or removes escalation policy step members.

skills.name: Query Telemetry
skills.description: Queries logs, traces, errors and metrics in Better Stack and runs the queries to investigate production problems.

skills.name: Search Docs
skills.description: Searches Better Stack documentation and returns the contents of relevant articles directly in the conversation.
